task: Arcanea visual world engine loop for canon-safe generated assets, social crops, gallery routing, and VIS-ready metadata.
surface: Arcanea image gallery, Atlas/Genesis/Studio seeds, social source frames, story/webtoon/book/music portals.
audience: AI-native creators, worldbuilders, webtoon/anime creators, musicians, storytellers, founders, and Arcanea operators.
first_read: Arcanea turns mythic creative intelligence into concrete proof artifacts, canon worlds, and reusable creator assets.

references.label: Arcanea canon locked truths
references.reason: Prevents incorrect lore, Guardian, Godbeast, Luminor, Nero, Shadow, and Realm usage.

references.label: Arcanea visual doctrine
references.reason: Defines luxury cosmic myth-tech, faction materials, silhouettes, lighting, and anti-patterns.

references.label: Arcanea TASTE.md
references.reason: Keeps product chrome AI-lab premium and avoids fantasy-game execution.

references.label: Instagram original content and creator practices
references.reason: Requires original, recommendation-safe content and informs vertical creator publishing.

references.label: TikTok creative best practices
references.reason: Supports hook-first structure and early proposition clarity.

references.label: YouTube Shorts official docs
references.reason: Confirms current Shorts duration capability and vertical/square planning context.

references.label: X creative best practices
references.reason: Informs concise copy, clear message, and sound-off creative strategy.

keep: Mind-bending scale with clear human or artifact anchor.
Arcanea luxury cosmic myth-tech materials: obsidian, starlight metal, gold thread, living crystal, ancient paper, dark glass.
Awe, responsibility, and usable creative power.
Prompt and metadata structure that can feed VIS, DB, galleries, and future web3 review.
avoid: Generated in-image text, logos, fake UI, and microtype.
Canon errors, especially treating Luminor as a species or Nero as evil.
Purple cliche, neon hacker grid, node/orbit filler, stock fantasy, and overdecorated clutter.
direction.signature: Proof becomes myth; myth becomes usable creative infrastructure.
system: Asset tier B generated media for first visual batch.
Deterministic overlays later for exact social/site text.
VIS-style ledger with canon refs, prompt file, asset path, score, verdict, failure modes, and next improvement.
